mapper.select:
select bc1.coupon_name, ccr.card_number, ccr.card_id, if(isnull(bc.sold_date) , null, bp.name) as buyer, bp1.name as activator, max(ccr.current_amount) as beginDeduction, sum(case when ccr.occur_type = 2 then ccr.occur_amount else 0 end) as thisDeduction, sum(case when ccr.occur_type = 3 then ccr.occur_amount else 0 end) as thisDeductionRefund, min(ccr.current_amount) as endDeduction from coupon_change_record ccr inner join base_card bc on bc.card_id = ccr.card_id inner join base_coupon bc1 on bc1.coupon_id = ccr.coupon_id left join base_patient bp on bp.patient_id = bc.sold_target left join base_patient bp1 on bp1.patient_id = bc.patient_id where
`ccr`.`coupon_id` in
#{item}
and (ccr.occur_date >= #{query.startDate} and ccr.occur_date < DATE_ADD(#{query.endDate} ,INTERVAL '1' DAY))
and (`bp`.`name` like concat('%', #{query.patientKeyword}, '%') or `bp`.`mobile` like concat('%', #{query.patientKeyword}, '%') or `bp`.`pinyin_name` like concat('%', #{query.patientKeyword}, '%')) and (`bp1`.`name` like concat('%', #{query.patientKeyword}, '%') or `bp1`.`mobile` like concat('%', #{query.patientKeyword}, '%') or `bp1`.`pinyin_name` like concat('%', #{query.patientKeyword}, '%'))
group by ccr.card_id, ccr.patient_id
